nodes.name: pairs
nodes.notes: Why Code: builds one item per Kraken pair from the shared KRAKEN_PAIRS constant and flags backfill when the Manual Trigger ran; the shared engine file is pasted on top.

nodes.name: weekly-keys
nodes.notes: Why Code: aggregates all pairs into the weekly candle keys with the shared engine (weeklyKeys, nowFrom); too much logic for native nodes.

nodes.name: find-old
nodes.notes: Why Code: filters system candles-* keys older than 26 weeks using the shared weekStart; needs JSON parsing per key.

parameters.content:
## paper-trading-prices
Every 5 min: Kraken 4h OHLC for 6 pairs -> weekly candles-* keys + now. Manual Trigger = backfill (all weeks Kraken returns). Prune branch deletes system candles older than 26 weeks at 03:00-03:04 UTC. Paste dist/n8n-prices.js on top of the weekly-keys Code node (pairs and find-old carry only the small pieces they use, see n8n/WORKFLOWS.md).
